observations.description: Attacker enters area and is brought down
Kane shown preparing the penalty, England trailing 0–1
Penalty scored; goalkeeper dives the other way
Goal and replay show low finish; score becomes 1–1

lines.text: Into the box... and he's brought down!
Penalty! The referee points straight to the spot.
Kane steps up. A chance to bring England level.
Kane scores! Low to the left, and England have the goal
The keeper goes the wrong way. Kane keeps it low, right into the corner. England are level.
